description: Surfaces that scripts/check_surface_coverage.py may leave undocumented in AGENTS.md and the .agents domain rules. An exemption is a recorded decision, not an oversight: each one says why the surface is internal. The check fails if an exempted surface later becomes documented, so this list cannot quietly rot.

exemptions.why: Fixture data for the convergence promotion gate, not a policy anyone reads or edits by hand. The gate it feeds (check_convergence_promotion_gate.py) is documented; the fixtures are its inputs.

Superseded schema retained so historical catalog records stay validatable. The current authority, config/model-catalog-schema-v2.json, is documented; naming both would imply a choice that no longer exists.
